title: gnaphalium canescens subsp. thermale
intro: Gnaphalium canescens subsp. thermale, commonly known as Desert Cudweed, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Desert Cudweed include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and supporting respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
